name: Daintree by Mana
description: A villa community of 150+ 4 BHK homes on 20 acres off Sarjapur Road. Mana planned the layout with sun-path and wind-flow simulation, and the homes use insulated cooling tiles and wind-powered turbo ventilators.
curation: A layout planned with sun-path and wind-flow simulation
Rainwater from roofs and walkways is collected, stored, and treated on site
About 2.5 km from International School Of Management Excellence
connectivity: International School Of Management Excellence, about 2.5 km
photoDescription: A row of villas with lit facades at dusk
